newsitem.title: USA: Von Hoffmann Press issues $100 mln in 144A debt.
newsitem.headline: Von Hoffmann Press issues $100 mln in 144A debt.

text.p: The following 144A debt issue from Von Hoffmann Press Inc was priced on Thursday via lead manager Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette, according to a high-yield syndicate source.

The offering will, in part, fund a leveraged buyout of the company led by a DLJ investment partnership. The St. Louis, Missouri-based company is the nation's largest manufacturer of four-color hardbound and softbound educational textbooks.
The deal was increased in size by $25 million.
